definition: The tasks remained aligned with the agreed requirements without unexpected, unplanned requirement changes. Assess stability separately from how well the student adapted; changes are not necessarily the student's fault.
positive_criteria: Explicitly describes requirements remaining stable during the reporting period
Shows work following the agreed requirements with only planned clarification
negative_criteria: Reports unexpected requirement changes, reversals, or new requests that disrupted the tasks
Reports rework caused by unplanned changes to requirements
